parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units holding stacked boxes and red crates. A large beige air filter unit sits on a pallet in the center. In the background, there's an open doorway, blue trash bins, and more storage racks under fluorescent lighting.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall gray metal shelving unit on left, partially obstructing view. Holds wooden pallets and cardboard boxes. Red vertical label on front. Appears freestanding on concrete floor.

objects.label: air filter unit
objects.observation: Large rectangular beige air filter unit with grid pattern, resting on a wooden pallet. Positioned centrally in aisle. Appears freestanding on concrete floor, facing camera.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Red plastic crates stacked on lower shelves of shelving unit. Located near bottom left of frame. Partially obscured by shelving structure. Rests on concrete floor.

objects.label: blue trash bin
objects.observation: Blue plastic trash bin standing near doorway in background. Located to right of doorway. On concrete floor. Partially blocked by shelving unit.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: Open doorway in back wall leading to another area. Has yellow curtain partially visible inside. Framed by concrete walls. Allows view into adjacent space.
